required_behavior: Implement the design in result-p27-cw19-design-01.md section 3 units U1, U2, U3 in order (each with its own red->green tests before the next), adjusted by C-D71 (docs/features/core-workbench/DECISIONS.md#C-D71) — the user decisions override the design's defaults where they differ:

C-D71 (1) survivors: previous-incarnation processes (same boot, pid + start_ticks identity) are never auto-killed; list them in status / UI recovery line / shutdown list and in the manager's backend-restart notice and workbench_status; add a manager-only bridge tool (e.g. `stop_survivor {survivor_id, reason}`) that re-verifies identity (same boot, pid, start_ticks, owner) right before signalling (TERM, grace, KILL of that exact process / its own session as existing pane close does), records reason/requester/time/outcome, and refuses unknown or changed identities; unknown-identity entries are display-only. Update the manager recovery skill and tool descriptions briefly.

C-D71 (2) same-boot restart + open Task -> one 'backend_restarted' notice to the new manager session after reconcile (with survivors and the reconcile summary); never while paused, before confirm_boot, or under metadata/model hold (deferred until allowed, sent once).

C-D71 (3) boot marker changed -> AdmissionHold boot_confirmation_required: hold every Workbench-originated automatic action (to_worker dispatch of experiment and free-work Tasks, worker terminal tool, watchdog/recovery notices, 60 s review, new experiments); allow user direct pane input, pane restart (C-D62/63), takeover, pause/resume, cancel, status. CLI `confirm-boot` shows environment/execution conditions and confirms (durable); UI only shows the waiting state (C-D58).

C-D71 (4) model error hold per role lifts passively when that role's next assistant turn ends without error; no probe requests. C-D71 (5) project 512 MiB raw log cap applies to experiment run raw logs via RawLogStore; worker terminal logs keep 64 MiB/command only.

Also: durable pause across backend crash (R4), _write_record fail-soft with metadata failure display (R3), previous backend.json read before overwrite and reconcile against /proc identity with boot_id compared first (pid reuse), never-submitted outbox messages lost in a crash listed as 'queued, not sent' when the journal shows them (R9), full shutdown via CLI shows active work and asks confirmation; failure to verify termination is never shown as success (C-AC-22).

Write scope: the PLAN CW-19 scope plus the backend files named in the design (service.py, cli.py, automation.py, flow*.py, workflow/run.py, omp_bridge/g3/bridge.ts, omp_bridge/skills/workbench-recovery, ui/product/model.py, contracts/ui_v1.py, app/recovery*.py, backend/boot*.py, policy/recovery_manager/port_sqlite.py) and their tests.
